sources.h1: Ibanez NTS Tubscreamer with KORG Nutube Technology
sources.excerpt: Ibanez NTS Tubscreamer with KORG Nutube Technology | boostoddistortion Cart Checkout MENU Home Gitariniai efektai EFFECT PEDALS Music Stands Flutes Acoustic Guitars Home / guitar / pedalsandeffects / stompboxes / boostoddistortion / Ibanez NTS Tubscreamer with KORG Nutube Technology Ibanez NTS Tubscreamer with KORG Nutube Technology SKU: 171053 Category: boostoddistortion , guitar , pedalsandeffects , stompboxes $300.82 $149.00 In stock Ibanez NTS Tubscreamer with KORG Nutube Technology quantity Add to cart Description Ibanez NTS - Tubescreamer with in-built KORG Nutube Throughout the late 1970's and early 1980s the Ibanez Tube Screamer was introduced to the world in a number guises, but each version of the pedal had the same thing in common: tone to die for! This has led to them being one of the most popular, commonly heard, and commonly cloned effects pedals available - but despite the number of copies out there, there's none better than the original. Until, perhaps, now... Perfect Tone, now with built-in Nutube Technology! Ibanez's brand new NTS (Nutube Tubescreamer) is the next step on the path to improvement for one of the most coveted effects pedals of the last 35 years. Featuring everything that made the original so popular, and more, the NTS has got us at PMT more excited than we have been in a long time. KORG Nutube KORG's Nutube technology is seeing a meteoric rise in popularity amongst amplifiers, synths, stage pianos and more. This fabulous piece of technology offers instruments/amplifiers those same characteristic rich overtones that valve amps are renowned for, but the Nutubes themself are much smaller, robust, lightweight, and above all power-efficient than conventional vacuum tubes. Including a Nutube into the circuitry of a Tubescreamer is a stroke of genius, as you can now get a genuinely authentic-sounding, hard-driven valve-amp characteristic from the pedal itself! High Grade Electronics In addition to the Nutube, Ibanez have included their most advanced circuitry yet in the NTS. The Relay True Bypass nature of the pedal ensures that the quality of your guitar's tone is preserved, regardless of how hard you push the drive circuit. The addition of a Mix control takes this even further, allowing you to determine just how much of the overall output is Overdrive, and how much is Clean, so your guitar's articulation and clarity need never be sacrificed. Available To Order Now This amazing little pedal is brand Available To Order Now, so look out for it landing at our 16 stores nationwide! Alternatively, order this pedal online today and make use of our fabulous free home-delivery service! Highlights A new take on the classic Tubescreamer overdrive pedal Built-in KORG Nutube provides those warm, characteristic tube-amp sounds Controls: Drive, Tone, Level and Mix controls Circuitry: Relay True Bypass Power supply: One 9 Volt battery or External DC 9-18 Volt AC adapter You may also like Stagg 5-Way Effect Pedal Power Supply Snake $ 3.78 Original price was: $3.78. $ 2.27 Current price is: $2.27.
